Beyond Ukraine : What to Know About Russia Escalating Confrontation With NATO
France would defend eastern flank borders even outside NATO, says Mélenchon
latvia.description: The far-left presidential candidate also criticized Germany's rearmament in an interview with POLITICO.

latvia.title: Le Pen says she won’t leave NATO until Russia’s war in Ukraine ends
latvia.description: The French presidential front-runner still plans to take Paris out of the military alliance's integrated command, she tells POLITICO.

latvia.title: Erdoğan tells UN that Europe cannot be safe without Turkey
latvia.description: Speaking at the UN General Assembly, Erdoğan argued that Turkey is an indispensable part of European security architecture. Turkey has been a NATO member since 1952 but its EU accession process has been frozen for nearly a decade.

latvia.title: Videóban kért bocsánatot az Országos Mentőszolgálat főigazgatója a félresikerült posztjuk után
latvia.description: Constantinovits Miklós szerint ez nem az az irány, amerre szeretnék, hogy a mentőszolgálat haladjon.

latvia.title: Dán hírszerzés: Oroszország fokozni fogja a hibrid háborúját, egy NATO-tagállam elleni katonai támadás sem kizárt
latvia.description: Moszkva célja a NATO megosztása – állapította meg a dán hírszerzés jelentése.

latvia.title: Pályázaton keresik a Nemzeti Sportügynökség új vezetőjét
latvia.description: Az előző vezérigazgatót szeptember elején mentette fel a belügyminiszter, akinek tárcája már több feljelentést tett a szervezet működését érintően.

latvia.title: Videóban kért bocsánatot az Országos Mentőszolgálat főigazgatója, miután a temetése napján büszkélkedtek el egy férfi megmentéséről
latvia.description: Átvizsgálták a korábbi működésüket, és észlelték, hogy ezt a hibát korábban többször elkövethették.

latvia.title: Betörtek az oroszok a NATO légterébe, katasztrófa szélén Oleski - Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról csütörtökön
latvia.description: Meghívták Vlagyimir Putyin orosz elnököt a decemberi G20 csúcsra, az Egyesült Államokba, a Kreml azt nyilatkozta, hogy fontolóra veszik a dolgot. Az orosz megszállás alatt álló Oleski városának humanitárius ellátása teljesen összeomlott, az ukránok szerint az oroszok mesterségesen éheztetik ki a települést. A donyecki fronton az oroszok Dobropillját, Kosztyantynivkát és Limant szorongatják, a harkivi fronton több település orosz megszállás alá került a napokban. Az orosz erők többször is megsértették a NATO légterét: tegnap egy Mi-8-as, ma egy drón hatolt be a szövetség országaiba engedély nélkül. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül.

latvia.title: Elárulta a NATO erős embere, milyen választ adnak a növekvő orosz fenyegetésre
latvia.description: A NATO fokozza a hírszerzési adatok megosztását az orosz hibrid fenyegetésekre válaszul - nyilatkozta a Reutersnek Alexus Grynkewich, a szövetség európai erőinek legfõbb parancsnoka a The Guardian beszámolója szerint.

latvia.title: Orosz támadás miatt evakuált két határátkelőt a NATO egyik legerősebb országa
latvia.description: Nyugat-ukrajnai orosz légitámadások miatt evakuálták csütörtökön a lengyelországi Dorohuskban és Hrubieszówban működő lengyel-ukrán határátkelőket - közölte csütörtökön Donald Tusk lengyel kormányfő.

latvia.title: SaS žiada vládu, aby podporila jasné postoje prezidenta Pellegriniho k vojne na Ukrajine
latvia.description: Opozičná SaS žiada vládu, aby jasne potvrdila súhlas s postojmi prezidenta Pellegriniho k Ukrajine, rešpektovaniu medzinárodného práva a našim záväzkom v NATO.

latvia.title: Ťažký týždeň: Kašleme NATO
latvia.description: Andrej Danko rozpútal „prestrelku“ s ľuďmi, s ktorými sa prehupol do parlamentu. A to zďaleka nie je všetko.

latvia.title: Američania nechávajú časť obrany na pleciach Európy. A čo článok 5?
latvia.description: Spojené štáty budú naďalej poskytovať kľúčové, ale zároveň obmedzenejšie kapacity Severoatlantickej aliancie (NATO), zatiaľ čo Európania preberajú väčšiu úlohu v obrane kontinentu. Agentúre Reuters to dnes povedal vrchný veliteľ aliančných síl v Európe Alexus Gtrhewich. NATO podľa neho posilňuje zdieľanie informácií a spravodajstva v reakcii na hybridné útoky.

latvia.title: Raport: Rusia ar putea ataca o țară NATO în următoarele luni, avertizează serviciile secrete daneze
latvia.description: Rusia ar putea desfășura în lunile următoare o operațiune militară limitată împotriva uneia dintre țările NATO, a declarat Serviciul de Informații și Securitate Militară (DDIS) al Danemarcei.

latvia.title: „Reacționează doar la forță”. Avertismentul dur al premierului Republicii Moldova, Vasile Tofan, privind acțiunile lui Putin
latvia.description: Premierul Republicii Moldova, Vasile Tofan, a dezvăluit, într-un interviu pentru CNN, care este „secretul” care a făcut ca ţara sa să reziste intenselor încercări de destabilizare din partea Rusiei, avertizând totodată că Europa trebuie să fie pregătită să se confrunte cu şi mai multă propagandă din partea Moscovei, care face posibilă victoria unor partide extremiste în ţări cu democraţii consolidate. În legătură cu survolul dronelor, el a spus că nu consideră că există o ameninţare iminentă pentru Moldova în ceea ce priveşte o potenţială incursiune, fiind de părere că Rusia mai degrabă testează ţările NATO. Rusia nu reacţionează la slăbiciune, ci reacţionează doar la forţă, a avertizat şeful guvernului de la Chişinău.

latvia.title: Ce spune Predoiu despre propunerea unei Poliții unice: „Urez succes în discuţiile cu organizaţiile asociative ale primarilor din ţară”
latvia.description: Ministrul interimar de Interne, senatorul Cătălin Predoiu, declară joi că, dacă ajunge în Parlament, va vota Guvernul Siegfried Mureşan, el arătând că este nevoie urgentă de un guvern pro-occidental cu puteri depline.

latvia.title: Olanda anunţă prelungirea operațiunilor de Poliție Aeriană. Dronele MQ-9 Reaper vor rămâne în România până la 31 decembrie 2027
latvia.description: Olanda prelungeşte din nou desfăşurarea dronelor sale MQ-9 Reaper care operează din Câmpia Turzii, în România, anunţă, joi, Ambasada Olandei în România. Avioanele fără pilot vor contribui acum la apărarea Flancului Estic al NATO până la 31 decembrie 2027.

latvia.title: „Rusia a pierdut deja războiul din Ucraina”, susține președintele unei țări NATO și UE
latvia.description: Rusia „a pierdut deja” războiul împotriva Ucrainei, a afirmat președintele lituanian Gitanas Nausėda, invocând costurile militare „enorme” suportate de Moscova.

latvia.title: Avioane de vânătoare poloneze, ridicate pentru a intercepta un aparat de spionaj rus Il-20, în largul coastei Mării Baltice
latvia.description: Avioanele de vânătoare poloneze au interceptat marți un avion de spionaj rus în largul coastei poloneze a Mării Baltice, a declarat ministrul Apărării, Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz.

latvia.title: Ce prevede acordul istoric privind Groenlanda: noi baze militare, reguli pentru investiții și promisiuni pentru NATO
latvia.description: Statele Unite, Danemarca și Groenlanda au semnat, marți, un acord de securitate menit să pună capăt lunilor de tensiuni privind teritoriul danez autonom, după amenințările repetate ale președintelui american Donald Trump de a prelua controlul asupra vastei insule arctice. Reuters a prezentat câteva componente cheie ale acordului, care se adaugă unui pact americano-danez din 1951 privind apărarea Groenlandei, conform unui text publicat de Guvernul danez.

latvia.title: Nicușor Dan, la CNN: Nu e foarte probabil ca Rusia să atace o țară NATO în următorii unu-doi ani, dar trebuie să fim pregătiți
latvia.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan, aflat la New York pentru cea de-a 81-a sesiune a Adunării Generale a Organizaţiei Naţiunilor Unite, a declarat că „nu este foarte probabil” ca Rusia să atace o ţară NATO „în următorii unu-doi ani”, dar România trebuie să fie pregătită. De asemenea, şeful statului nu crede că Rusia este cu adevărat pregătită să pună capăt războiului şi apreciază că preşedintele Donald Trump „are dreptate” că Europa trebuie să se implice mai mult în propria apărare.

latvia.title: NATO învață în țările baltice cum să poarte un război în epoca dronelor: De ce „un tanc pe câmpul de luptă este acum ca un tort”
latvia.description: În țările baltice, forțele NATO încearcă zilele acestea să învețe noul mod de a face război, folosindu-se de lecțiile de pe frontul ucrainean, iar militarii văd cum doctrina militară tradițională a devenit învechită și neadecvată.

latvia.title: Un senator republican cere o anchetă a Congresului SUA cu privire la nunta lui Donald Trump Jr, finanțată de un oligarh rus
latvia.description: Senatorul republican John Curtis a cerut marţi deschiderea unei anchete în Congresul american cu privire la finanțarea de către un om de afaceri rus a unor festivităţi cu ocazia nunţii lui Donald Trump Jr, fiul mai mare al preşedintelui american.

latvia.title: „Măsura disperată” pe care spionajul militar din Scandinavia nu vrea să o excludă: Invazie rusă într-o țară NATO, „în lunile următoare”
latvia.description: În cea mai nouă evaluare a lor despre amenințarea rusă, serviciile de informații militare daneze consideră o invazie a Moscovei drept „o măsură disperată”. latvia.title: Marine Le Pen afirmă că Franța nu va părăsi NATO până când războiul Rusiei din Ucraina nu se va încheia
latvia.description: Marine Le Pen dorește în continuare să retragă Franța din comanda integrată a NATO — dar nu va face acest lucru atâta timp cât războiul Rusiei din Ucraina continuă să facă ravagii. „Atâta timp cât există un război la porțile Europei, nu este momentul să luăm măsuri în acest sens, dar, desigur, intenția mea de […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Tarmo Miilits: Russia shows no intent to attack a NATO country right now
latvia.description: Let's turn the fear temperature down, because we have no signs indicating that Russia currently intends to militarily attack any NATO ally, writes Tarmo Miilits.

latvia.title: Saaremaa residents oppose Elering's planned Estonia–Latvia overhead power line
latvia.description: Many Saaremaa residents — as well as the Saaremaa municipal government — do not support Elering's plan to build a 330 kV Estonia–Latvia overhead power line across Saaremaa. Locals prefer an underground cable or a subsea cable running directly to Latvia.

latvia.title: Illegal immigration to Estonia rises, border rotation extended
latvia.description: Interior Minister Igor Taro (Eesti 200) says illegal immigration into Estonia has grown. Estonia is extending its border‑guard rotation on the Latvia–Belarus border.

latvia.title: Eesti annetajate rahaga žongleerija ootab endiselt Ukrainasse kohtukulli ette saatmist

latvia.title: INTERVJUU ⟩ Jaapan pelgab Ukraina sõjaga Hiina käsualuseks muudetud Venemaad
latvia.description: Venemaa teeks Taiwani konflikti korral tõenäoliselt midagi Hiinale kasulikku, sest Ukraina sõda on neist teinud Pekingi käsualuse, arvab jaapani julgeolekuekspert Masafumi Iida.

latvia.title: Politician Stepaņenko's father blacklisted in Latvia
latvia.description: Sergey Fedotov, the father of politician Jūlija Stepaņenko (Sovereign Power/Union of New Latvians), a candidate in the 15th Saeima elections, has recently come to public attention. On Thursday, Foreign Minister Baiba Braže (New Unity) added Fedotov to Latvia’s list of undesirable persons, barring him from entering the country for an indefinite period.

latvia.title: Border controls on grain shipments to be introduced in Latvia
latvia.description: To ensure that cargoes stolen in Ukraine, including grain, are not transported through Latvian territory, the Saeima adopted an amendment to the Animal Feed Circulation Law in its final reading on Thursday, 24 September, according to the Saeima’s press office.

latvia.title: Latvia will send up to 20 soldiers to clear Hormuz
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, the Saeima approved the participation of the National Armed Forces (NBS) in multinational military operations to secure the Strait of Hormuz. Latvia plans to deploy up to 20 soldiers to clear the Strait of Hormuz of mines.

latvia.title: Man murders relative in Rīga, drops body on street
latvia.description: In mid-September, a woman showing signs of a violent death was found in Rīga, in the Jugla neighbourhood, near a block of flats, the State Police reported on September 24.

latvia.title: Charity concert for Ukraine to take place Sunday in Rīga
latvia.description: On 27 September at 5.00 pm, ‘Brūzis Manufaktūra’, Brīvības gatve 401, Rīga, will host the ‘Ganta Foundation’ charity concert and storytelling evening, ‘Stories That Must Be Heard’, the organisers announced.

latvia.title: Excise tax on fuel to be reduced in Latvia
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, the Saeima approved, at its final reading, amendments to the Law on Limiting Price Increases for Petroleum Products, which provide for a reduction in the excise duty rate on diesel fuel and unleaded petrol from 1 October until the end of the year.

latvia.title: Saeima conceptually agrees to being audited
latvia.description: On Thursday, 24 September, the Saeima supported, at first reading, amendments granting the State Audit Office the right to carry out a financial audit of the accuracy of the annual report prepared by the Saeima.

latvia.title: Salaspils unveils new concert hall
latvia.description: Whilst Rīga is still waiting for a new concert hall, a multifunctional and modern concert hall has opened its doors nearby – in Salaspils, Latvian Television reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Latvia will host 2030 BMX world championship
latvia.description: Latvia has secured the right to host the BMX World Championships in Valmiera in 2030, and this will be the first time such a high-level competition has been held in a Baltic state, Toms Markss, Secretary General of the Latvian Cycling Federation (LRF), told Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Politician Stepaņenko's family reportedly friendly with Russian arms dealer Bout
latvia.description: ‘Sovereign Power/Union of New Latvians’ is among the frontrunners in the polls ahead of the Saeima elections expected in early October. Its Prime Minister candidate Jūlija Stepaņenko has in recent weeks avoided answering questions about her father, who lives in Russia and from whom she has received substantial gifts, Latvian Television reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Rail Baltica's deadline officially extended by all Baltic States
latvia.description: The much-touted target date of 2030, by which the first phase of the “Rail Baltica” railway project – worth more than 14 billion euros – was due to be completed, is no longer a realistic prospect, as finally officially acknowledged by the leaders of the Baltic states, Latvian Radio reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Police chase 13-year-old reckless driver in Latvia
latvia.description: The State Police has reported an unusal chase where the driver was 13 years old.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 23rd December, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Attempts to reduce fuel prices being put forward in Latvia
latvia.description: Several draft laws aimed at reducing fuel prices are being put forward for approval by the Saeima. This was decided on Wednesday by the Saeima’s Budget and Finance (Tax) Committee, according to the Saeima Press Service.

latvia.title: Don't dump your apples in the nearest (or farthest) forest
latvia.description: With harvest in full swing, the question of where to put left-over apples, grass and other organic waste becomes more pressing for many home and garden owners.

latvia.title: Infection affects dozens of children in Salaspils kindergarten, Latvia
latvia.description: At the “Jāņtārpiņš” kindergarten in Salaspils, dozens of children have been found to be suffering from an illness of unknown origin. Similar symptoms have also been observed in several adults – members of the nursery staff. The Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (SPKC) has already launched an epidemiological investigation, and the Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) will carry out inspections on Wednesday, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Reminder issued to vaccinate dogs against canine distemper virus
latvia.description: Foxes in Ādaži Municipality have recently been laboratory-confirmed as infected with canine distemper (CDV); therefore, the Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) urges dog owners to ensure that their dog has been vaccinated against this highly contagious viral disease.

latvia.title: Latvians will get European-standard cards for disabled parking
latvia.description: To ensure that people with disabilities have uniform rights to use parking concessions throughout the European Union, the Latvian Ministry of Transport has drawn up amendments to the Road Traffic Regulations, which provide for a gradual transition from the current disabled parking card to the new European parking card.

latvia.title: Hacker detained in Latvia for at least two cyberattacks
latvia.description: On 15 September this year, the State Police arrested a hacker born in 2003 on suspicion of carrying out cyber-attacks against at least two Latvian companies for financial gain, the police said on September 23.

latvia.title: Latvia approves vague plan for curbing immigration
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 22 September, the Government endorsed the plan for measures to restrict immigration drawn up by the Ministry of the Interior (MoI), which includes more than 70 recommendations for controlling and restricting immigration.

latvia.title: Latvian government imposes restrictions on two Russian oligarchs
latvia.description: On Tuesday, the Latvian government imposed nationwide financial and entry restrictions on the Russian oligarchs Mikhail Fridman and Alisher Usmanov, according to documents attached to the agenda of the Cabinet of Ministers’ meeting.

latvia.title: Concerns about traffic flow during repairs of major Rīga bridge
latvia.description: What will the traffic situation be like in Rīga when the dilapidated Vanšu Bridge is repaired? With about a year to go before work begins, this remains unknown. Businesses and the Mārupe Municipal Council are concerned about this, Latvian Radio and Latvian Television reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Road safety week saw more accidents but fewer casualties this year in Latvia
latvia.description: The “Roadpol Safety Days” campaign, organised by the European traffic police network “Roadpol”, has come to an end. During the campaign, police forces across Europe, including in Latvia, focused more actively on road safety than they do on a day-to-day basis, Juris Jančevskis, Head of the Response Directorate at the State Police, said in an interview with Latvian Television on Wednesday morning.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 22nd September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Rīga Music Week returns in November
latvia.description: The organisers of Riga Music Week have announced the first 28 artists for the city festival, hailing from eight countries. The festival will take place on 4 and 5 November across seven stages in the Tallinas Street quarter, according to the organisers.

latvia.title: Two out of three jewellery burglars caught in Jelgava, Latvia
latvia.description: Following a chase on Thursday, 17 September, the State Police arrested two people in Jelgava who had burgled a jewellery shop in Bauska a week earlier, the State Police have reported.

latvia.title: Latvian company gets European design award
latvia.description: The Latvian company ‘Carbon Less Future’ has won an award from the European Union Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO) in the ‘Entrepreneurs and Small Businesses’ category of the ‘DesignEuropa Awards’, LSM.lv reports on September 22.

latvia.title: 'Ulya' a slam dunk amongst Latvian public
latvia.description: Last weekend, Viesturs Kairišs’ feature film Uļa/Ulya became the most-watched film in Latvia on the opening weekend.

latvia.title: Man arrested in Rīga on suspicion of sexual harassment
latvia.description: On 18 September, officers from the Riga Regional Directorate of the State Police detained a man born in 1998 at a shopping centre in Riga, who had allegedly approached underage girls and offered them money in exchange for engaging in sexual acts. The suspect has been remanded in custody.

latvia.title: Ombudsman reports malnutrition at orphanage in Latgale
latvia.description: Ombudsman Karina Palkova has identified significant violations of children’s rights at a children’s home in Latgale, including inadequate nutrition and funding for the children’s needs, as well as staff failing to communicate sufficiently in the state language, Palkova said in an interview on the Latvian Radio programme “Good Morning” on September 22.

latvia.title: Drug bust in Rīga and Ādaži last week
latvia.description: Last week, the police arrested an organised group of six people in Rīga and the surrounding area on suspicion of drug dealing. Several storage facilities were uncovered, and a large quantity of various narcotic substances was seized: cannabis, cocaine, amphetamine and other substances, police said on September 21.

latvia.title: Rīga will seek to slow heating price rise
latvia.description: The Minister for Economic Affairs, Viktors Valainis (Union of Greens and Farmers), has instructed ‘Rīgas siltums’ and the Ministry of Economic Affairs (EM) to draw up proposals this week on how to reduce the expected rise in heating tariffs in Riga. The company currently estimates that the tariff could rise by 20 to 30 per cent from December.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 21st September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Possible air threat warning in Krāslava municipality of Latvia is over
latvia.description: The National Armed Forces have issued a warning covering Krāslava municipality regarding a potential threat to airspace. A cell broadcast alert was sent to residents of this municipality. The warning that had been issued ended shortly before midnight.

latvia.title: Most household energy consumption goes to heating in Latvia
latvia.description: According to the Central Statistical Bureau survey on energy consumption in households, published on September 21, 83.9 % of the energy resources consumed in households in 2025 were used for space and water heating.

latvia.title: National Alliance kicks out violence apologist Dalbiņš
latvia.description: The Executive Committee of the National Alliance (NA) has decided to expel Valts Dalbiņš, a candidate for a seat in the 15th Saeima, from the party, as he has, in posts on social media, justified violence against women and levelled prejudiced accusations against them.

latvia.title: Temporary bridge to be installed during Vanšu Bridge repairs in Rīga
latvia.description: A temporary bridge is to be erected whilst the Vanšu Bridge is being rebuilt, the Mayor of Riga, Viesturs Kleinbergs (Progressives), has stated on September 21.

latvia.title: Less than 1% turnout in Latvia for Russia's so-called elections
latvia.description: According to the State Police, 290 Russian citizens in Rīga took part in the Russian "elections", representing just 0.8 per cent of all Russian citizens eligible to vote in Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvian bank profits down 2.9% in first half of 2026
latvia.description: The Latvian banking sector posted a profit of 205.301 million euros in the first half of this year, which is 2.9 per cent less than in the corresponding period of 2025, according to data published by the Latvian Central Bank (Bank of Latvia) on September 21.

latvia.title: Hint of summer might still come next week in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that rain is expected frequently in Latvia this week.

latvia.title: More details emerge in big illegal cigarette case in Latvia
latvia.description: Almost two years ago, the police uncovered an illegal cigarette distribution network; some of those involved are now in the dock, whilst others are still awaiting trial. The initial investigation has given rise to several parallel cases, Latvian Television's De Facto reported on September 21.

latvia.title: Buzzing honey yields this year in Latvia
latvia.description: For the fourteenth year running, the Latvian Beekeepers’ Association (LBB) has been organising the ‘Honey Day at the Apiary’ event, with the aim of promoting honey and other bee products to the public. Throughout the month, around 30 apiaries across all regions opened their doors to the public, TV Kurzeme reported on September 20.

latvia.title: 'Catch some flavour' in Kuldīga, Latvia this week
latvia.description: In Kuldīga, the gastronomic event “Catch the Flavour!” is extending into the autumn with beloved seasonal dishes made mainly of spuds. Overall, it has been a busy summer for restaurateurs, and there is still a steady flow of visitors in September, Latvian Radio reported on September 21.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 20th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Rain and thunder across Latvia on Monday
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that rain is expected across Latvia on Monday.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Poland international volleyball
latvia.description: A crucial win over Turkiye on September 16th means Latvia has made it into the knock-out stages of the men's European volleyball championships.

latvia.title: LISTEN: Pēteris Vasks sacred music concert
latvia.description: The closing concert of the 29th International Sacred Music Festival featured a special concert of music by this year’s jubilee composer Pēteris Vasks, who is 80 years old.

latvia.title: Latvian border guards stop more illegal crossers
latvia.description: On Thursday, September 17, in Krāslava Municipality, border guards, in cooperation with State Police officers, detained a person transporting individuals who had illegally crossed the state border.

latvia.title: Kulbergs and Braže meet U.S. envoy to Belarus
latvia.description: On Thursday, 17th September 2026, the Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, met with the US Special Envoy to Belarus, John Coale.

latvia.title: KNAB to investigate ZZS handing out booze
latvia.description: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) will investigate an incident in which the Union of Greens and Farmers (ZZS) gave bottles of black balsam to senior citizens, KNAB said on September 18. This week, on the Latvian Radio programme “Krustpunktā”, a listener asked ZZS MP Augusts Brigmanis to comment on the fact that, at a seniors’ gathering in Ogre on 23 August, the ZZS had given small souvenirs to senior citizens, including a “small bottle of black balsam” bearing the ZZS’s list number for the forthcoming Saeima elections.

latvia.title: Andrejs Ēķis ar nozares pārstāvjiem ASV filmu industrijai piedāvā Latviju: “Varam konkurēt par lielu filmu un seriālu uzņemšanu!”
latvia.description: Latvijas Investīciju un attīstības aģentūras (LIAA) organizētās Latvijas uzņēmēju tirdzniecības misijas ASV filmu nozares programmā Latvijas kino uzņēmumi un profesionāļi no 23. līdz 25. septembrim Losandželosā prezentē filmēšanas, starptautisku kopražojumu, animācijas un pēcapstrādes iespējas. Kopējā tirdzniecības misija norisinās līdz 27. septembrim Valsts prezidenta Edgara Rinkēviča darba vizītes laikā. Filmu nozares dalībniekiem notiek tikšanās ar ASV […]

latvia.title: Pēteris Apinis: Kamēr cilvēks guļ, viņa acis tiek attīrītas no atkritumiem. Par redzes saistību ar veselību
latvia.description: Acu veselība ir vairāk nekā redze. Acis atspoguļo visa ķermeņa veselību. Toties uzturs, kustības, emocijas un ikdienas ieradumi ietekmē acis. Acis ir organisma veselības spogulis un sensors – rūpes par acu veselību nozīmē rūpes par savu sirdi, smadzenēm un kopējo dzīves kvalitāti. Acis ir vienīgā vieta organismā, kur ārstam ir iespēja tieši un bez invazīvām […]

latvia.title: Latviešiem atņem pēdējo naudu pat par holesterīna zālēm, bet Skotijā dod bez maksas, Vācijā jāpiemaksā tikai kapeikas
latvia.description: Latvijā sirds un asinsvadu slimības joprojām ir viens no galvenajiem nāves cēloņiem, taču cilvēkiem, kuriem nepieciešama ilgstoša holesterīna līmeni pazeminoša terapija, daļa izdevumu jāsedz pašiem. Tas rada jautājumu – vai valstī ar tik augstu kardiovaskulāro slimību slogu medikamentu pieejamība ir pietiekama? Pašlaik Latvijā noteiktām diagnozēm, kas saistītas ar lipīdu vielmaiņas traucējumiem, medikamentiem paredzēta 75% kompensācija. […]

latvia.title: FOTO. Seni franču zīmējumi, kuros redzams, kā cilvēki 1900. gadā iztēlojās 2000. gadu
latvia.description: Nevar noliegt, ka ir interesanti aplūkot, kā mūsdienas redzēja cilvēki laikā, kad pa ielām pārvietojās cilvēki zirgu pajūgos, bet internets, putekļsūcēji-roboti un citas ekstras pat sapņos nerādījās. Apritējis vairāk nekā gadsimts, kopš franču vizionāri nolēma ieskatīties tālajā 2000. gadā – un rezultāts izrādījās reizē komisks, sirreāls un spocīgi pravietisks. Šos zīmējumus 1899., 1900., 1901. un […]

latvia.title: 12 ar dzelzi bagāti pārtikas produkti, kurus ir vērts iekļaut savā uzturā
latvia.description: Dzelzs ir organismam ļoti svarīgs minerāls, jo tam ir būtiska nozīme skābekļa tranportēšanā pa visu ķermeni. Ja uzturā dzelzs nav pietiekami, var veidoties tā trūkums, tāpēc ir vērts iekļaut ikdienas uzturā pārtikas produktus, kas ar šo minerālvielu ir īpaši bagāti. Dzelzi iespējams uzņemt gan ar dzīvnieku, gan augu valsts produktiem. Tomēr organisms šīs dzelzs formas […]

latvia.title: “Mēs arī tādus Latvijā varētu atrast.” Mārcis Auziņš nosauc, kas varētu uzlabot demogrāfisko situāciju valstī
latvia.description: Latvijas demogrāfiskās situācijas uzlabošanā nozīme var būt ne tikai ekonomiskajai labklājībai, bet arī tam, cik droši un vienoti cilvēki jūtas savā valstī. TV24 raidījumā “Preses kubs” profesors, Latvijas Universitātes Padomes priekšsēdētājs Mārcis Auziņš skaidroja, kā sabiedrības noskaņojums un drošības sajūta var ietekmēt demogrāfiju. Auziņš norādīja, ka pasaules mērogā vērojama tendence – jo pārtikušāka kļūst sabiedrība, […]

latvia.title: Izrādās, arī tam ir nozīme… Psihoterapeite atklāj ideālo vecuma starpību veiksmīgām attiecībām
latvia.description: Lai gan mēdz teikt, ka mīlestībai nav vecuma ierobežojuma, attiecībās partneru vecuma atšķirība dažkārt var ietekmēt ikdienu, kopīgos plānus un skatījumu uz nākotni. Īpaši tas var kļūt pamanāms pāriem ar lielu vecuma starpību, jo laika gaitā var atšķirties gan dzīves prioritātes, gan finansiālie mērķi, gan vēlme veidot ģimeni. Taču vai pastāv tāda vecuma starpība, kas […]

latvia.title: “Nedēļu ēdīšu sausu maizi, bet labāk atlikšu naudu no pensijas!” Paciente pārsteigta par pieredzēto zināmā ārstu praksē
latvia.description: Vizīte pie ārsta pacientam nereti sākas ar satraukumu vēl pirms ieiešanas kabinetā. Tāpēc arī šķietami vienkāršām lietām – laipnam vārdam, paskaidrojumam par kavēšanos vai mierīgai sarunai – var būt liela nozīme. Ar savu pieredzi sociālajā tīklā “Facebook” dalījusies Daina, kura pēc nesenas vizītes īpaši izcēlusi attieksmi dr. Federa praksē. Sieviete raksta, ka uz katru ārsta […]

lithuania.title: France would defend eastern flank borders even outside NATO, says Mélenchon
lithuania.description: The far-left presidential candidate also criticized Germany's rearmament in an interview with POLITICO.

lithuania.title: Le Pen says she won’t leave NATO until Russia’s war in Ukraine ends
lithuania.description: The French presidential front-runner still plans to take Paris out of the military alliance's integrated command, she tells POLITICO.

lithuania.title: Erdoğan tells UN that Europe cannot be safe without Turkey
lithuania.description: Speaking at the UN General Assembly, Erdoğan argued that Turkey is an indispensable part of European security architecture. Turkey has been a NATO member since 1952 but its EU accession process has been frozen for nearly a decade.

lithuania.title: Videóban kért bocsánatot az Országos Mentőszolgálat főigazgatója a félresikerült posztjuk után
lithuania.description: Constantinovits Miklós szerint ez nem az az irány, amerre szeretnék, hogy a mentőszolgálat haladjon.

lithuania.title: Dán hírszerzés: Oroszország fokozni fogja a hibrid háborúját, egy NATO-tagállam elleni katonai támadás sem kizárt
lithuania.description: Moszkva célja a NATO megosztása – állapította meg a dán hírszerzés jelentése.

lithuania.title: Videóban kért bocsánatot az Országos Mentőszolgálat főigazgatója, miután a temetése napján büszkélkedtek el egy férfi megmentéséről
lithuania.description: Átvizsgálták a korábbi működésüket, és észlelték, hogy ezt a hibát korábban többször elkövethették.

lithuania.title: Betörtek az oroszok a NATO légterébe, katasztrófa szélén Oleski - Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról csütörtökön
lithuania.description: Meghívták Vlagyimir Putyin orosz elnököt a decemberi G20 csúcsra, az Egyesült Államokba, a Kreml azt nyilatkozta, hogy fontolóra veszik a dolgot. Az orosz megszállás alatt álló Oleski városának humanitárius ellátása teljesen összeomlott, az ukránok szerint az oroszok mesterségesen éheztetik ki a települést. A donyecki fronton az oroszok Dobropillját, Kosztyantynivkát és Limant szorongatják, a harkivi fronton több település orosz megszállás alá került a napokban. Az orosz erők többször is megsértették a NATO légterét: tegnap egy Mi-8-as, ma egy drón hatolt be a szövetség országaiba engedély nélkül. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül.

lithuania.title: Elárulta a NATO erős embere, milyen választ adnak a növekvő orosz fenyegetésre
lithuania.description: A NATO fokozza a hírszerzési adatok megosztását az orosz hibrid fenyegetésekre válaszul - nyilatkozta a Reutersnek Alexus Grynkewich, a szövetség európai erőinek legfõbb parancsnoka a The Guardian beszámolója szerint.

lithuania.title: Orosz támadás miatt evakuált két határátkelőt a NATO egyik legerősebb országa
lithuania.description: Nyugat-ukrajnai orosz légitámadások miatt evakuálták csütörtökön a lengyelországi Dorohuskban és Hrubieszówban működő lengyel-ukrán határátkelőket - közölte csütörtökön Donald Tusk lengyel kormányfő.

lithuania.title: SaS žiada vládu, aby podporila jasné postoje prezidenta Pellegriniho k vojne na Ukrajine
lithuania.description: Opozičná SaS žiada vládu, aby jasne potvrdila súhlas s postojmi prezidenta Pellegriniho k Ukrajine, rešpektovaniu medzinárodného práva a našim záväzkom v NATO.

lithuania.title: Ťažký týždeň: Kašleme NATO
lithuania.description: Andrej Danko rozpútal „prestrelku“ s ľuďmi, s ktorými sa prehupol do parlamentu. A to zďaleka nie je všetko.

lithuania.title: Američania nechávajú časť obrany na pleciach Európy. A čo článok 5?
lithuania.description: Spojené štáty budú naďalej poskytovať kľúčové, ale zároveň obmedzenejšie kapacity Severoatlantickej aliancie (NATO), zatiaľ čo Európania preberajú väčšiu úlohu v obrane kontinentu. Agentúre Reuters to dnes povedal vrchný veliteľ aliančných síl v Európe Alexus Gtrhewich. NATO podľa neho posilňuje zdieľanie informácií a spravodajstva v reakcii na hybridné útoky.

lithuania.title: Raport: Rusia ar putea ataca o țară NATO în următoarele luni, avertizează serviciile secrete daneze
lithuania.description: Rusia ar putea desfășura în lunile următoare o operațiune militară limitată împotriva uneia dintre țările NATO, a declarat Serviciul de Informații și Securitate Militară (DDIS) al Danemarcei.

lithuania.title: „Reacționează doar la forță”. Avertismentul dur al premierului Republicii Moldova, Vasile Tofan, privind acțiunile lui Putin
lithuania.description: Premierul Republicii Moldova, Vasile Tofan, a dezvăluit, într-un interviu pentru CNN, care este „secretul” care a făcut ca ţara sa să reziste intenselor încercări de destabilizare din partea Rusiei, avertizând totodată că Europa trebuie să fie pregătită să se confrunte cu şi mai multă propagandă din partea Moscovei, care face posibilă victoria unor partide extremiste în ţări cu democraţii consolidate. În legătură cu survolul dronelor, el a spus că nu consideră că există o ameninţare iminentă pentru Moldova în ceea ce priveşte o potenţială incursiune, fiind de părere că Rusia mai degrabă testează ţările NATO. Rusia nu reacţionează la slăbiciune, ci reacţionează doar la forţă, a avertizat şeful guvernului de la Chişinău.

lithuania.title: Ce spune Predoiu despre propunerea unei Poliții unice: „Urez succes în discuţiile cu organizaţiile asociative ale primarilor din ţară”
lithuania.description: Ministrul interimar de Interne, senatorul Cătălin Predoiu, declară joi că, dacă ajunge în Parlament, va vota Guvernul Siegfried Mureşan, el arătând că este nevoie urgentă de un guvern pro-occidental cu puteri depline.

lithuania.title: Olanda anunţă prelungirea operațiunilor de Poliție Aeriană. Dronele MQ-9 Reaper vor rămâne în România până la 31 decembrie 2027
lithuania.description: Olanda prelungeşte din nou desfăşurarea dronelor sale MQ-9 Reaper care operează din Câmpia Turzii, în România, anunţă, joi, Ambasada Olandei în România. Avioanele fără pilot vor contribui acum la apărarea Flancului Estic al NATO până la 31 decembrie 2027.

lithuania.title: Un elicopter militar rus Mi-8 a încălcat spațiul aerian al Poloniei, într-o nouă incursiune alarmantă
lithuania.description: Un elicopter militar rus de tip Mi-8 a pătruns miercuri în spaţiul aerian polonez în apropierea frontierei cu exclava rusă Kaliningrad, a declarat armata poloneză, acuzând Moscova că doreşte să pună din nou la încercare apărarea ţării, relatează TVPWorld. Într-un incident separat, calea ferată poloneză a fost din nou vizată. Marți seara, două trenuri de marfă au lovit blocuri de beton aflate pe șinele de cale ferată în estul Poloniei, dar niciunul dintre trenuri nu a deraiat și niciunul dintre mecanici nu a fost rănit.

lithuania.title: „Rusia a pierdut deja războiul din Ucraina”, susține președintele unei țări NATO și UE
lithuania.description: Rusia „a pierdut deja” războiul împotriva Ucrainei, a afirmat președintele lituanian Gitanas Nausėda, invocând costurile militare „enorme” suportate de Moscova.

lithuania.title: Avioane de vânătoare poloneze, ridicate pentru a intercepta un aparat de spionaj rus Il-20, în largul coastei Mării Baltice
lithuania.description: Avioanele de vânătoare poloneze au interceptat marți un avion de spionaj rus în largul coastei poloneze a Mării Baltice, a declarat ministrul Apărării, Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz.

lithuania.title: Ce prevede acordul istoric privind Groenlanda: noi baze militare, reguli pentru investiții și promisiuni pentru NATO
lithuania.description: Statele Unite, Danemarca și Groenlanda au semnat, marți, un acord de securitate menit să pună capăt lunilor de tensiuni privind teritoriul danez autonom, după amenințările repetate ale președintelui american Donald Trump de a prelua controlul asupra vastei insule arctice. Reuters a prezentat câteva componente cheie ale acordului, care se adaugă unui pact americano-danez din 1951 privind apărarea Groenlandei, conform unui text publicat de Guvernul danez.

lithuania.title: Nicușor Dan, la CNN: Nu e foarte probabil ca Rusia să atace o țară NATO în următorii unu-doi ani, dar trebuie să fim pregătiți
lithuania.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan, aflat la New York pentru cea de-a 81-a sesiune a Adunării Generale a Organizaţiei Naţiunilor Unite, a declarat că „nu este foarte probabil” ca Rusia să atace o ţară NATO „în următorii unu-doi ani”, dar România trebuie să fie pregătită. De asemenea, şeful statului nu crede că Rusia este cu adevărat pregătită să pună capăt războiului şi apreciază că preşedintele Donald Trump „are dreptate” că Europa trebuie să se implice mai mult în propria apărare.

lithuania.title: NATO învață în țările baltice cum să poarte un război în epoca dronelor: De ce „un tanc pe câmpul de luptă este acum ca un tort”
lithuania.description: În țările baltice, forțele NATO încearcă zilele acestea să învețe noul mod de a face război, folosindu-se de lecțiile de pe frontul ucrainean, iar militarii văd cum doctrina militară tradițională a devenit învechită și neadecvată.

lithuania.title: Un senator republican cere o anchetă a Congresului SUA cu privire la nunta lui Donald Trump Jr, finanțată de un oligarh rus
lithuania.description: Senatorul republican John Curtis a cerut marţi deschiderea unei anchete în Congresul american cu privire la finanțarea de către un om de afaceri rus a unor festivităţi cu ocazia nunţii lui Donald Trump Jr, fiul mai mare al preşedintelui american.

lithuania.title: „Măsura disperată” pe care spionajul militar din Scandinavia nu vrea să o excludă: Invazie rusă într-o țară NATO, „în lunile următoare”
lithuania.description: În cea mai nouă evaluare a lor despre amenințarea rusă, serviciile de informații militare daneze consideră o invazie a Moscovei drept „o măsură disperată”. lithuania.title: Marine Le Pen afirmă că Franța nu va părăsi NATO până când războiul Rusiei din Ucraina nu se va încheia
lithuania.description: Marine Le Pen dorește în continuare să retragă Franța din comanda integrată a NATO — dar nu va face acest lucru atâta timp cât războiul Rusiei din Ucraina continuă să facă ravagii. „Atâta timp cât există un război la porțile Europei, nu este momentul să luăm măsuri în acest sens, dar, desigur, intenția mea de […] © G4Media.ro .

lithuania.title: Tarmo Miilits: Russia shows no intent to attack a NATO country right now
lithuania.description: Let's turn the fear temperature down, because we have no signs indicating that Russia currently intends to militarily attack any NATO ally, writes Tarmo Miilits.

lithuania.title: Eesti annetajate rahaga žongleerija ootab endiselt Ukrainasse kohtukulli ette saatmist
lithuania.description: Pool aastat tagasi Interpoli vahistamismääruse alusel Austrias kinni peetud Hennadi Vaskiv, üks MTÜ-le Slava Ukraini tehtud annetuste võimaliku väärkasutuse peategelasi, ootab juba pikemat aega kohtupidamiseks Ukraina võimudele väljaandmist.

lithuania.title: INTERVJUU ⟩ Jaapan pelgab Ukraina sõjaga Hiina käsualuseks muudetud Venemaad
lithuania.description: Venemaa teeks Taiwani konflikti korral tõenäoliselt midagi Hiinale kasulikku, sest Ukraina sõda on neist teinud Pekingi käsualuse, arvab jaapani julgeolekuekspert Masafumi Iida.

lithuania.title: Zelenskis uz Maskavu dosies tikai “ar raķeti”
lithuania.description: Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis atkārtoti noraidījis Krievijas diktatora Vladimira Putina priekšlikumu rīkot sarunas Maskavā, Ņujorkā paužot, ka uz Maskavu dotos tikai “ar raķeti”. lithuania.title: Jo tālāk, jo trakāk: Stepaņenko tēvs gadiem ilgi atbalstījis Krievijas karaspēku Ukrainā
lithuania.description: Politiķes Jūlijas Stepaņenko (SV/J) tēvs Sergejs Fedotovs un viņa uzņēmums “Forma ŽBI” vairāku gadu garumā snieguši materiālu atbalstu Krievijas karaspēkam Ukrainā. lithuania.title: Lietuvā izplatās īpaši bīstama infekcija: zāļu nav, un jau 4 mirušie
lithuania.description: Daudziem rudens nav iedomājams bez izbraucieniem dabā – cilvēki dodas lasīt sēnes un ogas, kopt dārzus vai vienkārši pastaigāties mežā. Lietuvas Nacionālā sabiedrības veselības centra (NVSC) speciālisti atgādina, ka rudenī sākas otrais ērču aktivitātes vilnis, tāpēc saglabājas arī to pārnēsāto slimību risks. “Ērču aktivitāte rudenī ir saistīta ar to dzīves ciklu – pēc pavasara barošanās […]

lithuania.title: Nopludināts slepens ES dokuments atklāj jaunu, bīstamu draudu visai Šengenas zonai; šoreiz runa nav par militāru iebrukumu
lithuania.description: Kareivji, kuri atgriežas no Ukrainas frontes līnijas, Eiropas Savienībā ieved ieročus un militāro ekipējumu, brīdināts kādā konfidenciālā dokumentā. lithuania.title: Mantas Dubauskas. KAM balius, o kam pagirios
lithuania.description: Valdininkai puotauja maro, o tiksliau – karo metu. Per vieną vakarą prašvilpė tiek, kad vienam pensininkui būtų užtekę išgyventi šešerius metus. Žmonės po Krašto apsaugos ministerijos (KAM) renginio pasipiktino taip, tarsi linksmybėms būtų ištaškyta dešimtys tūkstančių eurų. Pala pala...

lithuania.title: Volodymyras Zelenskis sako esąs sukrėstas peiliu ginkluoto ukrainiečio Lenkijoje surengto užpuolimo
lithuania.description: Prezidentas Volodymyras Zelenskis ketvirtadienį pareiškė, kad Ukraina yra sukrėsta „piktadariško“ užpuolimo panaudojant peilį, kurį įvykdė ukrainietis, viename katalikų vienuolyne pietryčių Lenkijoje nudūręs kunigą ir sužalojęs dar keturis žmones.

lithuania.title: Berlynas patvirtino pasitraukiantis iš kovos dėl teisės rengti vasaros olimpiadą
lithuania.description: Berlynas ketvirtadienį patvirtino pasitraukiantis iš Vokietijos varžybų dėl teisės rengti vasaros olimpines ir paralimpines žaidynes, todėl potencialiais kandidatais liko tik Miunchenas ir vakarų Reino bei Rūro regionas.

lithuania.title: Apeliacinis teismas išnagrinėjo Gintauto Lukošaičio „čekiukų“ bylą: vis dar nesupranta, kuo nusikalto
lithuania.description: Lietuvos apeliacinis teismas ketvirtadienį baigė nagrinėti Šiaulių miesto savivaldybės tarybos nario Gintauto Lukošaičio „čekiukų“ bylą, kurioje sprendimą skelbti planuoja spalio pabaigoje.

lithuania.title: Rimo Bružo priekaištų sulaukusi LRT kontratakuoja: „Tai – spaudimas“
lithuania.description: Žurnalistas Rimas Bružas šią savaitę paskelbė, kad su LRT turintys žmonės turi pasirašyti dokumentą, kuriuo esą reikalaujama nekritikuoti LRT – ne tik rašyti kritiškų įrašų socialiniuose tinkluose, bet ir jų komentuoti bei paspausti „patinka“. LRT atstovai 15min paaiškino, kokius ribojimus numato nacionalinis transliuotojas ir įvertino žurnalisto retoriką.

lithuania.title: Skausminga avarija prie Ozo parko Vilniuje: prireikė gausaus būrio medikų ir pareigūnų
lithuania.description: Ketvirtadienio vakarą sostinėje susidūrė automobilis ir motoroleris. Prireikė medikų pagalbos.

lithuania.title: Klaipėdos centre „išsitaškė“ trys automobiliai: BMW išplėšė „Volvo“ ratą
lithuania.description: Ketvirtadienio popietę dėl eismo įvykio Liepų gatvėje Klaipėdoje kuriam laikui buvo apribotas eismas.

lithuania.title: Emigrantą iš Lietuvos kaltina kraupia avarija: nesuvaldė BMW – žuvo trys mokiniai ir direktorė
lithuania.description: Trys mažamečiai ir mokyklos direktorė žuvo per avariją Nyderlanduose, kurios sukėlimu kaltinamas greitį viršijęs ir BMW nesuvaldęs 20-metis iš Lietuvos. Nauju emociniu smūgiu gedinčioms aukų šeimos tapo tai, kad vietos teismas nutarė įtariamąjį Reinaldą Jurkų iki nuosprendžio paskelbimo paleisti į laisvę. Tiesa, nustatytos griežtos kardomosios priemonės.

lithuania.title: Sąjungininkės pasirengusios galimoms Rusijos hibridinėms atakoms, sako NATO vadovas
lithuania.description: NATO yra pasirengusi galimoms Rusijos kibernetinėms atakoms ir kitoms hibridinio karo formoms, ketvirtadienį pareiškė Aljanso generalinis sekretorius, ragindamas didinti paramą Ukrainai.

lithuania.title: Rusija suskaičiavo, kiek milijardų trūksta – rado, kas susimokės
lithuania.description: Rusijos valdžia trečius metus iš eilės ketina didinti mokestinę naštą piliečiams ir verslui, kad užpildytų federalinį biudžetą. Iki pusės visų biudžeto lėšų išleidžiama karui, o šiais metais biudžeto deficitas sieks beveik 7 trln. rublių (apie 71,4 mlrd. eurų), rašo „The Moscow Times“.

lithuania.title: Vokietijoje vykdomas tyrimas dėl 105 metų vyro, galimai nacių karo belaisvių stovyklos prižiūrėtojo
lithuania.description: Vokietijos prokurorai ketvirtadienį pranešė, kad atliekamas tyrimas dėl 105 metų vyro, įtariamo nusikaltimais nacių karo belaisvių stovykloje per Antrąjį pasaulinį karą.
